extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation Rules
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules for computing derivatives, including power, constant multiple, sum, and difference rules.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative f'(x) represents the instantaneous rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of finding a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n, then f'(x)=nx^{n-1}.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The Power Rule applies when n is any real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is constant and f is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, then d/dx[f(x)+g(x)] = f'(x)+g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, then d/dx[f(x)-g(x)] = f'(x)-g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function built from powers of x with constant coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function with base e; its derivative is itself.

extracted_concepts.name: a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponential function with base a; d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number satisfying lim_{h→0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A limiting process used to define e and derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm ln a appears in the derivative of a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of position: v(t)=s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function s(t) describing position over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of velocity: a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a derivative, written s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the cost function: MC=C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function C(x) representing total cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The interpretation of the derivative as a rate.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration.
